title: inspectScenarios
responsibility: Reads working-tree scenario and unit manifests to list capture summaries, show one scenario’s requirements, or report contract and coverage problems.

inputs.name: listScenarios.root
inputs.description: Optional repository root; defaults to process.cwd() and reads working-tree manifests.

inputs.name: showScenario.id
inputs.description: Scenario id to find in the working-tree scenario registry.

inputs.name: showScenario.root
inputs.description: Optional repository root; defaults to process.cwd().

inputs.name: checkScenarios.root
inputs.description: Optional repository root; defaults to process.cwd().

outputs.name: listScenarios
outputs.type: Promise<Array<{ id: string; kind: ScenarioManifest['kind']; title: string; units: string[]; captures: number; unproven: number; excluded: number }>>
outputs.description: Scenarios sorted by id, each with id, kind, title, covered units, required capture count, unproven state count, and excluded state count.

outputs.name: showScenario
outputs.description: Scenario manifest plus its required captures, unproven states, and inapplicable states.

outputs.name: checkScenarios
outputs.type: Promise<{ scenarios: number; errors: string[]; health: ScenarioHealth }>
outputs.description: Scenario count, schema and unknown-unit errors, and report-only viewport, coverage, and uncovered-unit health.

inputs.description: Optional repository root; defaults to process.cwd() and reads working-tree manifests.

outputs.type: Promise<Array<{ id: string; kind: ScenarioManifest['kind']; title: string; units: string[]; captures: number; unproven: number; excluded: number }>>
outputs.description: Scenarios sorted by id, each with id, kind, title, covered units, required capture count, unproven state count, and excluded state count.
